Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activity rows in assay CHEMBL1054504. Join activities to assays on assay_id, join activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN. Filter where assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1054504', activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL, and activities.standard_relation = '='. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
